name: Daniel Lamoreaux
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Daniel a birth date of 28 Nov 1796 and a wife, Maria Allen (1804-1863), married about 1821, with children born 1822-28. One of them was Samuel A. 'Lemoreux', whose Iowa death record names Daniel as his father (S1). The site and the Davenport genealogy give his wife as Martha Lum/Linn; FamilySearch attaches a Martha Linn death record to the John Lamoreux born 1754 instead.

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, Daniel Lamoreaux (LT7X-155), with attached index entries

researchLogEntry: Round 4: FamilySearch gives b. 28 Nov 1796, wife Maria Allen (not Martha Lum/Linn), and a son in Iowa.
